_comment: The Gladiateur's looks, imported from the Ascension client by localTools/ascensionImport/importVisuals.py:
key -> the SpellVisual id of the Ascension spell whose look it takes. Spells.ps1 names a look by the id the
import gives its key, or one of its kits (LookKit) in a stock visual's slot.
ShieldThrow: Shield Toss (cast and impact: shield bash, metal shield clangs); DuelState: Counter Stance (state:
shout ring and swords about the arms); Wound: Blood Strike (impact: wet blood hit; state: bleeding chest);
WoundBurst: Centurion Strike (gushing wound, blood burst); Opening: Ancestor's Fury (state: blood rage on the
hands); OpeningRing: Iron Will Fierce Smash (impact: sword flash, steel ring); BrokenGuard: Shield Block Fierce
Smash (impact: shield emblem, metal shield crunch); ArenaStorm and ArenaStormWhirl: retail Bladestorm's aura and
whirl (dust whirlwind); CoupDeGrace: Juggernaut (roar, blood rage on the weapons, a mark on the chest).
